Demo39 Luna, the secret bartender — prompts for the layered art (DEMO_DESIGN_GUIDE §6 标准制作流程) → project/web_prompts.json for
tools/openai/images.py. Character reference: her stream art from Demo14 (copied before Demo14 was replaced: assets/ref/luna_*.png →
assets/art/ref_luna.png / ref_luna_close.png). The first pose (luna_counter) becomes the character reference for every other pose.
Poses on chroma green (#00B140, "matte": "green": black hair with deep-blue streaks, white shirt, black vest — nothing green on her);
mouth / blink variants are masked edits from project/face_points.json (measured on each pose). Run: python3 scripts/prompts.py

bg_bar.prompt:
Image 1 is the ART STYLE reference only (do not draw her or her room). Same anime cel style, thin lineart, flat colours. Background plate only, NO people.

A small hidden basement cocktail bar late at night after last orders, seen from a bar stool at the counter (first person, eye level of a seated person). A dark polished wooden bar counter runs across the bottom of the picture. Behind it, in the middle: a back bar of softly back-lit glass shelves with rows of bottles (no labels, no readable writing), a few hanging brass lamps with warm amber light. On the LEFT: the foot of a narrow stone staircase and a heavy wooden door with a small window, cold blue rainy night light from outside, a wet umbrella stand. On the RIGHT: an old glowing jukebox with soft coloured light. Moody, quiet, intimate. The centre of the picture behind the counter is open (a person will stand there later).

Empty scene, no people. Wide 16:9 game scene. No text, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.

bg_seat.prompt:
Image 1 is the ART STYLE reference only (do not draw her or her room). Same anime cel style, thin lineart, flat colours. Image 2 is the bar itself: keep its materials, colours and light. Background plate only, NO people.

The same small basement bar late at night, seen from your bar stool turned to the LEFT, toward the empty stool next to you: the end of the dark wooden counter on the right side of the picture with a small candle, the next bar stool (empty) in the centre, behind it the bottom of the stone staircase and the wooden door with cold blue rainy light through its small window (towards the RIGHT background), warm amber lamps, back-lit bottle shelves blurred on the left. Eye level of a seated person, intimate, close. The centre of the picture is open (a person will sit there later).

Empty scene, no people. Wide 16:9 game scene. No text, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.

luna_counter.prompt:
Image 1 is the CHARACTER and STYLE reference: draw this exact young woman (face, eyes, hair, blue streaks, choker, earring). Image 2 is the same woman closer (face reference).

Art style EXACTLY like image 1: modern anime cel illustration, thin dark lineart, flat colours with one soft-edged but still flat shadow tone, a cool night palette. Hand-drawn feel, NOT glossy, no bloom, not realistic. Realistic adult proportions (not chibi), about 7 heads tall, a beautiful mature adult face.

Luna, 25: the exact young woman from image 1 — long straight black hair falling past her shoulders with deep-blue inner streaks (visible on the strands under her hair on one side), dark sapphire-blue eyes with long lashes, a cool mature face with a faint teasing smile, a thin black choker on her neck, a small silver crescent-moon earring. Tonight she is a bartender: a crisp white shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows and the top button open, a fitted black waistcoat (vest) over it, no tie, no jacket.

She stands behind the bar counter, centre, from the waist up, polishing a short crystal glass with a white cloth at chest height, looking at the viewer with a quiet, knowing half-smile, head slightly tilted. Mouth CLOSED.

Lighting on her: warm amber light from the lamps above the bar, a faint cool blue rim light from the LEFT side of the picture.

Plain flat CHROMA-KEY GREEN background (#00B140), one even colour, completely empty: no scenery, no bar counter, no bottles, no floor line, no shadow and no gradient on the background, no green anywhere on her or her props. Her whole head and hair inside the frame with space above; her shoulders and arms not cut by the left or right picture edge.

Wide 16:9 game scene. No text, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.

luna_counter_talk.prompt: Edit this exact image. Keep EVERYTHING identical — same pose, hands, framing, size, position, hair strands, clothes, colours, lighting and background — and change ONLY her mouth: slightly open as if talking softly, a small natural opening, no teeth showing. Do not move, zoom or crop the picture.

luna_counter_blink.prompt: Edit this exact image. Keep EVERYTHING identical — same pose, hands, framing, size, position, hair strands, clothes, colours, lighting and background — and change ONLY BOTH of her eyes: FULLY closed in a natural soft blink (upper eyelids all the way down on both eyes, lashes visible, no iris showing); her bangs stay exactly as they are. Do not move, zoom or crop the picture.
